text:
Priya S.: Ok team — day-zero alignment for ClearBridge POC tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final success criteria, confirmed eval prompts, answers to their security questionnaire, and clarity on pricing/credits. Quick agenda below.

Tom H.: I'll handle infra ops checklist. Are they using SSO? Any data residency requirements we should know?

Avery: They sent the security questionnaire yesterday. Link: https://files.clearbridge/sec-q1.pdf. Key asks: SOC2 scope, data retention policies, KMS usage, ability for client-side encryption. I can draft answers but need owners for some sections.

Raj P.: For success metrics the customer is asking for: 95th percentile latency < 300ms on chat with 512-token context, avg cost per 1k tokens <$1, and quality: >=80% pass on their prompt set (we'll run evals). Are those reasonable to commit for the POC?

Sofia M.: We should define the prompt set now: 200 queries across core intents + ~20 adversarial prompts. I'll upload the template to the shared drive and include examples.

Priya S.: Good. Tom, can Dedicated hit that 95th <300ms target at 512 tokens? If not, we need fallback plan (lower context or model variant).

Tom H.: On Dedicated with nv4x2 it's borderline. With batch_size=1, KV cache warm, synthetic tests show ~280ms median but 95th can spike to ~330ms under concurrency. Recommend: reserve 1 GPU pool for them, disable autoscale during demo, set batch_size to 1. If we can't guarantee, we offer fallback to rwd-3b for higher tail perf.

Raj P.: I'll prepare an eval harness and run a smoke baseline against both rwd-4b and rwd-3b overnight. Plan: produce pass/fail per prompt + confusion cases. Will share CSV by EOD.

Avery: For the SQ: can someone confirm whether they require HSM-backed KMS? If yes we need legal + infra signoff; that may add 3-4 business days.

Sofia M.: Pricing ask: they requested a 3-week trial credit and a dedicated trial SKU with discounted rate. Sales suggested $5k credit + 20% POC discount. @Priya S. can you confirm we can commit?

Priya S.: Confirmed: Offer $5k trial credit, 2-week pilot ramp (we'll extend to 3 weeks if needed), optional dedicated trial with a $2k setup fee to cover reserved capacity. I'll log terms in SFDC under opportunity CB-POC-2212.

Tom H.: Ops note: they'll connect from a fixed set of IPs and want inbound firewall rules. Need IP list + contact for VPN. Also we need to pre-provision certs if they want mTLS. @Raj P. can you own the IP exchange?

Raj P.: I can own IP exchange and test harness. Also putting a short runbook in the repo:
```
# smoke test (example)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","input":"<test prompt>"}'
```

Priya S.: Great. Stakeholders attending tomorrow: ClearBridge - Ellen (Product), Marcus (Security), Ty (Dev Lead). Our side: Priya, Tom, Raj, Avery, Sofia. Invite sent.

Tom H.: Putting runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-clearbridge. Contains infra checklist + rollback steps.

Priya S.: Action items / owners: Raj -> IP list + eval harness results by 18:00 PT today; Tom -> infra config + smoke run; Avery -> draft SQ answers & flag legal items; Sofia -> final prompt set + eval template; Priya -> finalize commercial terms in SFDC. Escalate any blocker to me ASAP. :thumbsup:
